dedupe_keys.name: data and code for routing resolved municipal landfill methane responsibility under alternative accounting conventions

description: A University of California Berkeley research team publishes data, derived facility factors, scripts and audit records for alternative municipal-landfill methane accounting conventions. Zenodo provides one reproducibility archive under CC BY 4.0. The description identifies tonnage-universe and facility-identity audits, protocol-practice recovery evidence, analytical outputs and a local workflow. These materials can inform simulated waste-routing and methane-responsibility scenarios when municipalities choose different accounting boundaries. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this release. Coverage is the source agencies and analytical conventions used in the associated manuscript, not direct methane measurements at every landfill. A limitation is that original CalRecycle and EPA records are not relicensed in the archive, and the historical builder of one frozen facility-factor table was not recovered. A checksum preserves the derived table but does not reconstruct its original computation. The ZIP was not downloaded, scripts were not run and emission totals were not independently checked.
